finding: SSA-JC 2025 Bowman Chrome Sapphire sales, routed after the Chourio ruling (Drew, 2026-09-06). Companion to backend/data/catalog-relocations/2026-09-06-ssa-jc-chourio.json.
ordering: CATALOG FIRST, POOL SECOND. The catalog list retires the Caglianone identity; this list then routes the sales. Run in the other order and these rows repoint onto an address whose rival row still exists.
rulings: SSA-JC IN 2025 BOWMAN CHROME SAPPHIRE IS THE JACKSON CHOURIO AUTOGRAPH (Drew, 2026-09-06). The checklist says the card IS an auto, so a Chourio sale routes to the :auto identity even though NOT ONE title in this population says AUTO. The absence of the word is not evidence against the checklist.

THE TITLES DO NOT NAME THE PLAYER, THE PARTITION DOES. #1866 recorded a 10/6 title split and read it as a player split. Measured again read-only 2026-09-06: the split is on the PRODUCT WORDS ('Bowman Sapphire' vs 'Bowman Chrome Sapphire') and NOT ONE of the 16 bare titles names any player. What separates them is the vendor partition, and both partitions are player-pure: 1769786601171x571370693030933250 is 9/9 Jackson Chourio, 1782708479171x113035842276264510 is 12/12 Jac Caglianone. Each carries titled AUTO sales naming its player outright, sitting beside the bare rows in the same CardHedge product.

A RETIRE MUST NOT SWEEP THE OTHER PLAYER'S SALES INTO THE SURVIVOR. Both partitions currently read the same no-auto identity that the catalog list retires. Repointing all of them to Chourio would move 11 Caglianone-attributed sales into Chourio's pool and price his card off another player's market. The Caglianone rows are PARKED instead.

A DESTINATION MUST BE CHECKLIST-BACKED (CF-CATALOG-MATCH-IS-SELF-CONFIRMING). Caglianone has no checklist-backed SSA-JC identity in 2025 - his only SSA-JC row anywhere is 2024 bowman-draft-sapphire. So his rows are parked, never routed: a repair does not mint an identity from a sale.

PARK, NOT RETIRE, FOR THE OTHER PLAYER. identityUnverified keeps a row out of every pool without asserting which card it belongs to, which is the honest state for a sale whose player is known and whose card is not yet in the catalog. If the 2025 Caglianone SSA-JC checklist is ever acquired, these rows are recoverable by that label.

EVERY ENTRY IS A PATCH IN PLACE. All 20 vendor rows sit in vendor-id partitions and the 21st already sits at the destination address, so this list contains no RELOCATE: nothing changes partition, and no document is deleted.
